Build 13 class is separate from implementation status and verification. not_read means not implemented/consumed; Unproven means the live shape lacks a sanitized receipt; runtime failures are temporary outcomes, not matrix classes. Restricted native data may still have a degraded fallback. Historical live receipts do not certify a new account, current production configuration or phone behavior.

last_checked is the repository-only review date for every row. last_verified retains the date and kind of the cited evidence: code dates may advance after source/test review; live dates advance only from dated repository receipts, never from this review. No live provider calls were made.

Exactly one class per capability or surface row. Restrictions and intentional supersession take precedence; otherwise a missing sanitized live-shape receipt is Unproven, even when code consumes the data. Used now describes the cited, bounded proof, not all accounts or optional subfields. Consumers on Unproven rows identify intended code paths, not live certification.

## Provider data Omen receives or could receive but does not read

Provider fields and endpoints that are observed or documented but that no code in src/ reads. 'observed' means a recorded live response in this repo showed the field; 'documented' means the provider's docs or community docs list it and nobody here has seen it live. The test fails when any of these starts being read, so move it into entries when that happens.

| Provider | Field | Seen | Opportunity | Value | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| espn | eligibleSlots | observed | Per-player positional eligibility remains unused. League-wide slots already come from mSettings lineupSlotCounts; these are distinct fields. | high | none; already arrives |
| espn | keeperValue / draftAuctionValue | observed | Keeper and auction leagues: the league's own valuation of each player. | low | only matters for keeper leagues |
| espn | proTeamSchedules | documented | Provider-side NFL schedule and bye per player. | low | Retain nflSchedule.js and warehouse/nflverse as canonical schedule/bye sources; provider shape remains unprobed. |
| sleeper | depth_chart_order / depth_chart_position | documented | Depth-chart role per player on a list Omen already fetches. | medium | Compare against warehouse weekly-roster depth_position before choosing authority; no sanitized Sleeper depth receipt found. |
| sleeper | traded_picks | documented | Pick ownership for trade context and trade value. | low | a live probe |
| sleeper | winners_bracket / losers_bracket | documented | Playoff bracket and outcomes for late-season screens. | low | a live probe |
| yahoo | bye_weeks | documented | Provider-side bye per player. | low | Retain nflSchedule.js and warehouse/nflverse as canonical schedule/bye sources; provider shape remains unprobed. |
| yahoo | has_recent_player_notes | documented | Flags a news item on a player; a prompt to look, not content. | low | News rights and the value of the flag remain unresolved; do not claim usable news content. |

## Vocabulary

- **available**: Omen reads it and uses it as the provider gives it.
- **degraded**: Omen reads or derives it, but with a stated limitation (see reason).
- **unavailable**: The provider offers nothing Omen can use for this.
- **not_read**: The provider may offer it, but Omen has no code that reads it.

- `provider_restricted`: The provider's terms or Omen's own verification stop it claiming an exact result.
- `requires_derived_projection`: Availability is not confirmed unless a derived projection exists.
- `probe_pending`: The mapping fails closed to not_determined until a live probe confirms it.
- `derived_projection`: The provider gives none; Omen derives one from another source, or leaves it null.
- `not_read_by_omen`: No code in Omen reads it.
- `deliberately_omitted`: The code leaves it out on purpose until a prerequisite exists.

- verification `code`: Checked against source by the drift test. Says what the code does, not what the provider returns today.
- verification `live`: Exercised against a real provider account; last_verified is that date.
